source_summary: Investigated an organic performance drop on /bueroreinigung reported by an L1-style finding. Opened the cited GSC snapshot and the deploy log independently.

atomic_claims.text: /bueroreinigung 7-day mean organic clicks fell from 41/day to 22/day starting 2026-08-18.
The page's top query 'büroreinigung rastatt' moved from average position 6.2 to 8.9 between 2026-08-11 and 2026-08-27.
The 2026-08-17 deploy changed shared header markup and did not change /bueroreinigung body content.

evidence_ledger.claim: /bueroreinigung 7-day mean organic clicks fell from 41/day to 22/day starting 2026-08-18.
evidence_ledger.calculation: 7-day trailing mean of daily clicks, computed for the window before 2026-08-18 and the window after.
evidence_ledger.falsification_test: If the daily click series for /bueroreinigung shows no step down around 2026-08-18, the claim is false.
evidence_ledger.limitations: Does not establish a cause; single page; no year-over-year comparison in the fixture.

evidence_ledger.claim: The top query moved from average position 6.2 to 8.9 in the window.
evidence_ledger.calculation: Mean of daily average position for the query, before vs after 2026-08-18.
evidence_ledger.falsification_test: If the query's daily position series is flat across 2026-08-18, the claim is false.
evidence_ledger.limitations: Position is an average across devices and locations; does not identify which competitor moved.

evidence_ledger.claim: The 2026-08-17 deploy changed shared header markup only.
evidence_ledger.raw_result: diff touched header partial; no change under the /bueroreinigung page body
alternative_explanations: a shared CSS change affected rendering of this page
evidence_ledger.falsification_test: If the deploy diff shows an edit to the /bueroreinigung page body, the claim is false.
evidence_ledger.limitations: Based on a diff summary, not a line-by-line review of every shared asset.

dedup_result: No prior resolved finding covers this exact page + window. Not a duplicate.
recency_check: GSC snapshot is 4 days old; deploy log entry is 14 days old. Both current enough for this analysis.
pss_comparison: PSS's own /bueroreinigung content was unchanged in the window; the change vector is external (SERP) or deploy-side (shared markup).
observed_facts: A deploy touched shared header markup on 2026-08-17 (EV-0003).
estimates: The deploy is unlikely to be the cause because it did not touch this page's body (medium confidence).
open_questions: Did a competitor gain positions for the top query?
What is the year-over-year August pattern for this page?
